search_intent: Compare FOB and CIF quotations for vehicles shipped from China to an African country, port and inland market
buyer_task: Audit a China->Africa vehicle FOB vs CIF quote to a named discharge port and inland corridor; decide what the term does/does not cover and where customs value, insurance and inland responsibility begin.

sources.title: International Chamber of Commerce
sources.facts_supported: Incoterms(r) 2020 Checklist: FAS/FOB maritime/inland-waterway only; FCA for any mode incl multimodal and terminal delivery; C-group (CFR/CIF/CPT/CIP) are shipment contracts - risk passes on delivery (on board) in seller's country while seller pays main carriage; under CIF seller must arrange minimum-cover cargo insurance (LMA/IUA Clauses C or similar), CIP requires all-risk cover (Clauses A).

sources.title: World Customs Organization
sources.facts_supported: WCO Valuation FAQ: invoice/transaction price is not automatically customs value; whether freight/insurance is added depends on importing country national law; customs may reject declared value after persistent doubt; six valuation methods apply in sequence (transaction value, identical, similar, deductive, computed, fallback). Scope = global framework only, proves no national rule.

sources.title: World Trade Organization
sources.facts_supported: WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VII GATT (customs valuation); framework not re-read this session; proves no national rule.

sources.title: Ghana Revenue Authority (Customs Division)
sources.facts_supported: Vehicle duty calculated on CIF value; first purchase price depreciated 0-50% by age down to FOB, FX applied, then freight and insurance considered; ICUMS duty check needs VIN/chassis, model, year, make; clearing documents Bill of Lading or Waybill + Title; third-party charges include local shipping line charge paid to carrier and terminal handling charges; VAT on duty-inclusive value.

sources.title: Kenya Revenue Authority
sources.facts_supported: Public notice 30/05/2025: effective 1 July 2025 a new Current Retail Selling Price (CRSP) schedule is applied in computing customs value for imported used motor vehicles; schedule published on KRA website. Kenya national practice only.

sources.title: Kenya Bureau of Standards
sources.facts_supported: Quality inspection of imports (Legal Notice 227/1995 and successors); imports not meeting Kenya standards are prohibited and returned at importer cost; pre-shipment inspection exists; at port of entry KEBS inspects entry form/packing list, samples, releases only compliant goods.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Under FOB the seller delivers and risk normally transfers once the goods are on board the buyer-nominated vessel (maritime rule).
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Incoterms 2020: FOB maritime only, risk on board.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Under CIF the seller pays main carriage to the named destination port and arranges insurance, but risk still transfers on board in China, not on African arrival.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: C-group = shipment contract; risk passes on board in seller country; CIF seller arranges minimum-cover insurance.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: For a container handed to a terminal before loading FCA fits better; for seller-arranged insured multimodal carriage CIP (all-risk level) is the matching rule.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: FCA any mode/terminal delivery; CIP all-risk (Clauses A).

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Invoice price is not automatically customs value; whether freight is added is determined by the importing country's national law.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: WCO FAQ Q5/Q6; national law decides freight treatment; sequential valuation methods.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: WTO Customs Valuation Agreement provides the global treaty basis for transaction-value valuation; framework only, not reopened this session.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Not reopened; global treaty, no African national rule.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Ghana assesses vehicle duty on a CIF basis: age depreciation to FOB, FX, then freight and insurance are considered; VIN/model/year/make are required to check duty in ICUMS.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: GRA: CIF-based duty, depreciation, freight & insurance considered, VIN-based ICUMS check.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Ghana clearing documents include Bill of Lading or Waybill plus Title; local shipping-line and terminal handling charges are third-party (destination) charges.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: GRA documents and third-party charge list.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Kenya applies a Current Retail Selling Price (CRSP) schedule to compute used-vehicle customs value effective 1 July 2025.
Kenya requires import quality inspection; non-compliant imports are prohibited and returned, with pre-shipment and port-of-entry inspection routes.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: KEBS import inspection procedures and Legal Notices.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Kenya's CRSP is Kenya-only and cannot be used as Ghana/South Africa/Nigeria valuation practice.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Single national schedule; WCO confirms national-law basis; no source extends CRSP abroad.
claim_source_matrix.NOTE: Negative/scope claim supported by KRA being a single national authority + WCO national-law principle.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Build five route cost blocks and assign a responsible party to each line; mark missing live quotations as open, not zero.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Procedural guidance, not an external factual assertion; requires no external source and must not be presented as a regulation.

blocked_facts: Specific duty/VAT/levy percentages beyond what GRA lists for Ghana; no other African country's rate captured.
Live ocean/inland freight, storage, detention, border transit and FX costs - require dated written quotations (TIME_SENSITIVE, not in body as fact).
RoRo/container/EV/damaged-vehicle carrier acceptance - carrier- and sailing-specific, no carrier primary captured.
Nigeria/South Africa or other third-country valuation rules - not captured this session (searches returned only T4).

Every deterministic body claim must map to a FACT_VERIFIED=true matrix row; CONTEXT_ONLY global sources may frame but never prove a destination rule.
Preserve candidate URL/canonical and all 12 locales; Research changes facts boundaries only.
